author: delegate-gp[bot]
title: Add staff test-mode sheet, menu item, and webapp tests [staff-test-mode]
body:
## Why

Story 3 of the `staff-test-mode` epic. The backend API (story 1) and flag/contracts (story 2) are already merged. This story wires the flag into gp-webapp so staff engineers can reach test-mode functionality directly from the dashboard sidebar.

The menu item is double-gated: the `staff-test-mode` Amplitude flag must be on **and** the signed-in user must have a `@goodparty.org` email. Both gates run client-side so the component tree stays lean (no server-action round-trip for a staff tool). The feature flag check uses `{ trackExposure: false }` — this is a staff-internal tool, not a product experiment.

The Sheet panel lets staff:
- **Create** a test organisation (campaign or elected office) with preset configuration — race, onboarding state, Pro tier, election timing, 10DLC status
- **Apply** presets to the active org (election results, membership state)
- **Delete** test orgs and auto-switch to the next remaining one

Mutations invalidate the full query cache and navigate to `/post-auth-redirect` so all downstream queries refetch against the new org context. The apply mutation additionally calls `clearElectionResultDismissed()` (same as the manual dismissal path) and refreshes the router so election-result UI rehydrates.

New Vitest coverage:
- `useTestMode`: create / delete / apply mutation `onSuccess` sequences
- `TestModeMenuItem`: flag-off, non-staff-email, and flag+email gate combinations

Membership test coverage extended to cover the `tenDlc` preset → texting-state mapping and corresponding banner rendering, which were previously untested.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Staff-gated UI that creates/deletes orgs and applies presets with broad query invalidation; backend guard is assumed but client email gating is not a security boundary.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds a **staff-only Test mode** entry in the desktop dashboard sidebar footer (above the account menu), wired to the existing `staff-test-mode` flag and a `@goodparty.org` email check so candidates never see it.
> 
> Opening it launches a **Test mode sheet** backed by new `useTestMode` React Query hooks: list/create/delete test organizations via `/v1/test-mode` APIs, apply preset families (onboarding, pro, election, term, 10DLC) on the active org, zip-based office lookup via `GET /v1/elections/races-by-year`, and post-mutation **full cache invalidation** plus org switch/navigation (`/post-auth-redirect` or `/serve/onboarding` for not-started elected offices). Apply also clears election-result dismissal and refreshes the router.
> 
> Typed **api-endpoints** entries and **FlaskConicalIcon** support the UI. Vitest covers menu gating, mutation side effects, **tenDlc preset → `deriveMembershipState` texting** mapping, and matching **MembershipBanner** copy for those states.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit fc14cbe36c782623ec5699cb4eb8c661ceb0e81a. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
